name: How long does it take to complete a primary bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a primary bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a primary bathroom addition can vary significantly, usually ranging from 8 to 16 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope. Factors such as the extent of structural changes, plumbing rerouting, and material availability directly impact the schedule. Opting for custom tile work or specialized fixtures, for example, can extend the duration compared to using readily available materials. Delays can also occur due to permitting approval processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary bathroom addition typically takes 8 to 16 weeks, influenced by project complexity, structural changes, and material availability. Custom finishes often extend the timeline.
